# PrimeMarkdown Features

## Text Styles

This is **bold** text, *italic* text, __underline__ text
and ~~strikethrough~~ text.

## Inline Code

Run `scan_md_files` then `parse_md` to build the document.

## Word Wrap

This is a deliberately long paragraph to verify that text
longer than the screen width wraps onto the next line
instead of being clipped at the right edge of the display.

## Inline Formulas

Inline formula: $e^{i\pi} + 1 = 0$ is Euler's identity.

## Block Formulas

$$
\int_0^1 x^2\,dx = \frac{1}{3}
$$

$$
\lim_{n \to \infty} \left(1 + \frac{1}{n}\right)^n = e
$$

## Code Block

```
int main(void) {
    return 0;
}
```
